title: Provider inventory still needs a generated data projection
observed_need: Provide a deterministic native data table of compiler-owned test, declaration, callable, and signature identities so the provider can validate runtime receipts; executable call selection belongs to the identity-bound runtime.
current_language_behavior: The compiler emits artifact-bound callable, declaration, test-case, and signature metadata. mncs-test resolves selected TestCase identities through the retained Session dispatcher and the native provider validates returned receipts.
why_insufficient: The identity invocation gap is resolved. A small deterministic generator remains only to project multiple source-module inventories into the provider bounded identity data table.
minimal_reproducer: tools/generate_provider.py --check projects the compiler inventories for tests/self_suite.mncs and tests/provider_cross_module.mncs into native/mncs/test/provider_inventory.mncs; it emits no executable calls or per-declaration match branches.
desired_direction: Remove the remaining data projection when the compiler/runtime exposes the multi-source declaration inventory directly to the provider artifact; no invocation semantics change is needed.
workaround: No callable-dispatch workaround remains. Keep the generator data-only until compiler-owned multi-source inventory is directly available in the provider artifact.
